\begin{proof}
Let $A\subseteq\mathbb{N}$. For each $n\in\mathbb{N}$, the usual metric satisfies $d(m,n)\ge 1$ whenever $m\ne n$. Therefore
\[
B(n,1/2)=\{n\},
\]
so every singleton of $\mathbb{N}$ is open. It follows that
\[
A=\bigcup_{n\in A}\{n\}
\]
is open. Also,
\[
\mathbb{N}\setminus A=\bigcup_{n\notin A}\{n\}
\]
is open. Hence $A$ is closed, since its complement is open. Thus every subset of $\mathbb{N}$ is clopen.
\end{proof}
